{{Top|leg}}
'''Bank Niro Eleven''' was a bank on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Niro 11]]. It had a reputation for having bank accounts for the fabulously rich and a great deal of privacy about those accounts. The manager of new accounts was [[Herk Bloomi]].

In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] the bank was visited by [[Clive Flax]] and [[Astri Oddo]], who were hoping to find information about [[Eve Yarrow]]. The bank was subsequently visited by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] looking to arrest the two.
